source.Name: Total population
source.Summary: Population: Total population and distribution by age and sex estimated to be  consistent with the population by age and sex of the (a) 1950, 1960, 1965,  1970, 1975, 1980, 1985, 1990, 2011 censuses; (b) population register  through 2018; (c) official estimates through 2018; and with estimates of  the subsequent trends in fertility, mortality and international migration.

source.Name: Total fertility rate
source.Summary: Fertility: Total fertility rate and age pattern of fertility based on: registered  births classified by age of mother and the underlying female population by  age through 2017.

source.Name: Life expectancy at birth
source.Summary: Overall Mortality: Life expectancy at birth and age pattern of mortality based on: (a)  official estimates through 2015; (b) registered deaths by age and sex  available through 2014; (c) International estimates used up to 2017.

source.Name: Infant/child mortality
source.Summary: Child Mortality: Under-five mortality based on: registered infant and child deaths through  2017.

source.Name: International migration
source.Summary: Migration: International migration based on: estimates derived as the differences  between overall population growth and natural increase.
